text: Density [Lat. densitas , thickness]: Ger. Dichtigheit ; Fr. densité ; Ital. densità . Familiarly, specific gravity. The quantity of matter, or mass, contained in unit volume of a body. At any given place it is proportional to the ratio of the weight of a body to its volume, whence the old term specific gravity. The concept being independent of gravity, the term density is now that most used in physics. ( S.N. )
